description: Round 28 diagnostic content-script: runs at DocumentStart (HeadParsed) so it wraps fetch/XHR/sendBeacon before the app's bootstrap caches its own references; captures page JS errors, unhandled rejections, console.error/warn, and logs every network call with ms-since-install timestamps into an on-page banner; also reports scheduler/postTask, serviceWorker, visibilityState, and probes live IntersectionObserver delivery. No behaviour change to the page beyond the banner and one sentinel div.
name: R28 Error Capture
